title: Because I was late
goal: Give a reason in one sentence with -dYgY üçin.

intro.text: Put the reason before the main verb with `-dYgY`, its possessive and *üçin*: *Wagty ýokdugy üçin gelmedi* (he didn't come because he had no time), *Gijä galandygym üçin* (because I was late). No accusative before *üçin*. *Sebäbi* and *şonuň üçin* still work too.

vocab.en: to be glad, to be pleased
exam, test (synagdan geçmek: to pass an exam)

exercises.question: How do you say **because I was late**?

why.2: *Üçin* can't follow a finished verb. Use `-dYgY`: *galandygym üçin*.
why.3: *Galandygy* is **because he or she was late**. For **I**: *galandygym*.

exercises.en: We stayed at home because it was raining.

exercises.label: *gijä galmak* + `-dYgY`, before *üçin*: because I was late, because you were late…
exercises.explain: The possessive endings say who: *-ym, -yň, -y, -ymyz, -yňyz*; for **they**, *-y* or *-lary*.

exercises.prompt: He didn't come because he had no time.
Aýna kesel bolandygy üçin işe gelmedi.
accept: Aýna did not come to work because she was ill.
Aýna did not come to work because she [was sick|had been ill|had been sick|got ill|got sick|fell ill].
Aýna did not [go to|come in to|go in to] work because she was [ill|sick].
Because she was [ill|sick], Aýna did not come to work.
Because Aýna was [ill|sick], she did not come to work.
Aýna missed work because she was [ill|sick].

exercises.question: Which sentence means the same as *Gelmedi, sebäbi wagty ýokdy*?

why.2: *Gelenden soň*: **after coming**, he had no time.

exercises.explain: *Sebäbi* in a second sentence, or `-dYgY üçin` in one: the same reason.

exercises.prompt: I'm learning Turkmen because I'm going to work in Ashgabat.
exercises.text: Aşgabatda işlejekdigim üçin türkmen dilini öwrenýärin.

exercises.prompt: We stayed at home because it was raining.
accept: Biz ýagyş ýagýandygy üçin öýde galdyk.
Ýagyş ýagýandygy üçin, biz öýde galdyk.
Ýagyş ýagýardy, şonuň üçin (biz) öýde galdyk.
exercises.explain: *ýagýan* (raining) + *-dygy* + *üçin*: the present `-ýAn`, since it was raining at that time.

exercises.question: *Gijä galandygym üçin, mugallym gaharlandy.* Why did the teacher get angry?

why.1: **Because he was late** would be *gijä galandygy üçin*.
why.2: *Gijä galmak* is **to be late**: I did come, but late.

accept: Merjen is happy because she passed the exam.
Merjen is [glad|pleased] because she [passed|has passed] the [exam|test].
Merjen is happy because she [has passed the exam|passed the test|has passed the test].
Because she [passed|has passed] the [exam|test], Merjen is [happy|glad|pleased].
Merjen is [happy|glad|pleased] because she [passed|has passed] an exam.

exercises.prompt: Mum is worried because I'm not at home.

reject.why: That is **because he isn't at home**. For **I**, the possessive is *-ym*: *ýokdugym*.

exercises.explain: *ýok* + *-dug-ym* (my) + *üçin*: because I'm not there. *-dYgY* goes straight after *ýok*.

exercises.title: Näme üçin gijä galdyň?
exercises.passage:
Düýn Döwran işe gijä galdy. Ol öýden çykmazdan öň, açaryny gözlemäge başlady. Açaryny tapýança, ýarym sagat geçdi. Açaryny tapandan soň, ol duralga ylgady, ýöne awtobus eýýäm gidipdi. Taksi ýokdugy üçin, ol işe pyýada gitdi.

Ol işe gelende, müdir ondan gijä galmagynyň sebäbini sorady. Döwran ähli zady gürrüň berdi. Döwranyň hiç haçan gijä galmaýandygy üçin, müdir gaharlanmady.
exercises.translation: Yesterday Döwran was late for work. Before leaving the house, he started looking for his key. Half an hour went by before he found it. After finding his key, he ran to the bus stop, but the bus had already gone. Because there was no taxi, he walked to work. When he got to work, the manager asked him why he was late. Döwran told him everything. Because Döwran is never late, the manager didn't get angry.

questions.q: What took Döwran half an hour?
questions.explain: *Açaryny tapýança, ýarym sagat geçdi*: until he found his key.

questions.q: Why did he walk to work?
questions.explain: *Taksi ýokdugy üçin*: because there was no taxi.

questions.q: Why didn't the manager get angry?
questions.explain: *Döwranyň hiç haçan gijä galmaýandygy üçin*: because Döwran is never late.
